_help: Named OSM objects drawn by their own shape list instead of the generic icon. Key: the OSM name tag of a statue, fountain or other scenery object. Units are metres from the object's point, +y down the screen (south), then multiplied by scale. Shapes, drawn in order: ["circle", x, y, radius, colour], ["rect", x, y, width, height, colour], ["polygon", [x1, y1, x2, y2, ...], colour], ["line", x1, y1, x2, y2, width, colour]. Colours are HTML hex, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

Toripolliisi.note: Oulu's 2.2 m bronze bobby on the market square (Kaarlo Mikkonen, 1987); drawn 2.2x to read from the taxi
